title: 第二十一回 蛊毒盗经第二十二回 紫煞罗女
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第二十一回蛊毒盗经
“堂妹，你真的要嫁给这样的人吗？”
慕其明的声音低沉而压抑，仿佛从喉咙深处挤出来一样。
闻听慕卉云决意要和孤鹤雁成婚，慕其明难掩心中焦虑与不甘，他想规劝一下慕卉云，让堂妹改变主意。
慕卉云闻言却是无比的惊讶：“婚姻，岂是儿戏，你看我像开玩笑的吗？”
慕其明闻听不悦：“堂妹，我真的无法理解你。”
“你只见他一面，就要嫁给他，你真的了解他吗？你了解他多少？！”
“你没看那个孤鹤雁，他看你的眼神还没容月多，人家在乎的是容月，不是你！”
慕卉云闻听轻声一笑，眼中带着几分不屑：“堂兄，你观察的还真细，可这又如何？”
“我爱的是他，只要能嫁给他，我不在乎他爱别人更多一些！”
慕其明闻听竟一时语塞，仿佛被什么东西堵住了喉咙。
他猛地打开手中的折扇，开始来回的踱步，仿佛在压抑心中的怒火。
慕卉云看得心中好笑：“堂兄，你这是犯了什么……病？”
“莫非，你也想嫁给他？哈哈，哈哈。”
慕卉云银铃般的笑，慕其明听着却像剜心一般，他不禁涨红了脸，猛一合手中的折扇道：“那好吧，你可别怪我没提醒你！”
“我可告诉你，那个人可是个先天残疾！”
“哦，先天残疾？”
慕卉云闻听挑了挑眉，故作惊讶地看着慕其明：“我怎么不知道？”
慕其明见状，眼中闪过一丝得意，仿佛抓住了什么把柄道：“我告诉你，那个人心脏有问题！”
“他的心，是外翻的！”
“你懂吧，心眼朝外，你就心里合计吧！”
慕卉云闻听却不禁得咯咯笑：“心眼朝外？我看你才是吧。”
慕其明闻听，气得直跺脚：“哎呀，我的堂妹啊！
我说的可是千真万确，一点不假啊！”
“不信，你可以问问老君。”
“你可不要跟人上了床，睡了才知道，到那时，后悔都晚了！”
慕卉云闻听，却是微微一笑：“堂兄，你操心的太多了，这个我早就知道了。”
“你早就知道？！”
慕其明闻听，脸现惊讶：“知道你还嫁给他？”
“嗯，这怎么啦？”
慕卉云闻听微微一笑，眼中带着几分通情与理解：“我们第一次见，他就告诉我了。
他心脏先天外突，正因为如此，他才来神望坡通灵，我们才得以相识。”
“他背容月回来时晕倒，老君替他疗伤，我帮他搽药，我也都看到了，我觉得没什么。”
“哎呀，糊涂！
糊涂！
你真是糊涂！”
慕其明闻听，气的不禁“啪”
的一下又打开手中的折扇，兀自对着自己一阵狂扇，全然没有了那种不徐不疾的谦逊样儿。
那折扇好像颇识得主人的心，腾的一下冒出火焰，火焰随着折扇上下起舞，映得他的脸色更加苍白，看上去既诡异，又好笑。
“你们觉得怎么样，好看吗？”
慕卉云穿上容月带回来的新娘子装扮，轻轻转了个圈，展示给大家看。
红绸似火，金线交织，凤冠霞帔，珍珠螺髻，那模样可真是：富贵花开娇生嫣，红裙拖曳步升莲。
黛眉如月寒山翠，人胜桃花抱春来。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Poison and Sutra Stealing
"Cousin, do you really want to marry such a person?"
Mu Qiming's voice was low and depressed, as if squeezed out from deep in his throat.
Hearing that Mu Huiyun was determined to marry Gu Heyan, Mu Qiming could not hide his anxiety and unwillingness. He wanted to persuade Mu Huiyun to change his cousin's mind.
Mu Huiyun was extremely surprised when she heard this: "Marriage is just child's play, do you think I am joking?"
Mu Qiming was displeased when he heard this: "Cousin, I really can't understand you."
"You only met him once and you are going to marry him. Do you really know him? How much do you know about him?!"
"You didn't look at that Gu Heyan. He didn't look at you for as long as Rong Yue. What he cares about is Rong Yue, not you!"
Mu Huiyun smiled softly upon hearing this, with a bit of disdain in her eyes: "Cousin, you are really observant, but so what?"
"I love him. As long as I can marry him, I don't care if he loves others more!"
"You...!"
Mu Qiming was speechless for a moment, as if something was blocking his throat.
He suddenly opened the folding fan in his hand and began to pace back and forth, as if suppressing the anger in his heart.
Mu Huiyun was amused: "Cousin, what kind of... disease have you committed?"
"Could it be that you also want to marry him? Haha, haha."
Mu Huiyun smiled like a silver bell, but Mu Qiming felt like his heart was being ripped out when he heard it. He couldn't help but blush. He slammed the folding fan in his hand and said, "Well, don't blame me for not reminding you!"
"I can tell you, that person is born with a disability!"
"Oh, born with a disability?"
Mu Huiyun raised her eyebrows upon hearing this, and looked at Mu Qiming in surprise: "Why didn't I know?"
When Mu Qiming saw this, a trace of pride flashed in his eyes, as if he had grasped something and said, "I tell you, that person has a heart problem!"
"His heart is turned out!"
"You know, your eyes are outward, so just make the calculation in your mind!"
Mu Huiyun couldn't help but giggle after hearing this: "Looking outward? I think you are the one."
Mu Qiming heard this and stamped his feet angrily: "Oh, my cousin!
What I said is absolutely true and not false at all! "
"If you don't believe me, you can ask Laojun."
"Don't go to bed with someone. You won't find out until you are asleep. By then, it will be too late to regret it!"
When Mu Huiyun heard this, she smiled slightly: "Cousin, you worry too much. I've known this for a long time."
"You knew this already?!"
Mu Qiming was surprised when he heard this: "I know you still marry him?"
"Well, what's going on?"
Mu Huiyun smiled slightly upon hearing this, with some empathy and understanding in her eyes: "He told me this the first time we met.
His heart was congenitally protruded. Because of this, he came to Shenwangpo for channeling and we got to know each other. "
"He fainted when he came back carrying Rong Yue. Laojun healed his injuries and I helped him apply medicine. I also saw it, and I thought it was nothing."
"Oh, you're confused!
Confused!
You are so confused! "
When Mu Qiming heard this, he couldn't help but "pop" in anger
With a sudden movement, he opened the folding fan in his hand and fanned himself wildly, completely losing his unhurried humility.
The folding fan seemed to know the owner's heart, and flames suddenly burst out. The flames danced up and down with the folding fan, making his face even paler. It looked weird and funny at the same time.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"What do you think? Does it look good?"
Mu Huiyun put on the bridal outfit that Rong Yue brought back, turned around slightly, and showed it to everyone.
The red silk is like fire, intertwined with gold threads, the phoenix crown is decorated with garlands, and the pearl conch bun is really what it looks like: wealth, flowers are blooming, and the red skirt is dragging up the lotus steps.
The dark eyebrows are like the moon and the cold mountains are green, and people are better than peach blossoms to embrace the coming spring.
